اغتسلوا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَسَلُوا (iḡtasalū) /iɣ.ta.sa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِغْتَسَلَ (iḡtasala)
# اِغْتَسِلُوا (iḡtasilū) /iɣ.ta.si.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِغْتَسَلَ (iḡtasala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
